thread:
elena (PM): heads-up — our Q2 launch window just slid by ~2 weeks after infra pushed back the dedicated pool.
sam (Eng): saw that, bump from infra. Do we keep current cutlist or rebaseline for v1? :thinking_face:
maria (Product Ops): customer asks (ACME & BetaCorp) increased pressure on tenant routing + audit logs. Both asked to be in MVP.
elena (PM): ACME is big but can we offer a pilot (limited capacity) instead of full MVP inclusion? That would reduce dev effort.
leo (SRE): pilot is feasible if we scope it to single-region + read-only audit export. We can't guarantee SLA parity with GA.
kevin (Design): UX for pilot needs a banner and clear expectations. Small copy change, + one modal. Low effort.
sam (Eng): realistic delta for full tenant routing + audit is ~3 sprints (including e2e tests). Pilot would be ~3 weeks.
elena (PM): proposal: ship MVP without tenant routing, include audit-export pilot for ACME. Move tenant routing to v1. Opinions?
maria (Product Ops): agrees — helps sales since ACME gets something now, but still sells v1 roadmap.
leo (SRE): +1. Also suggests we add a fallback routing policy to avoid tenant misrouting during pilot.
sam (Eng): fallback policy is small, can be done in current sprint. But full routing requires infra sloting which depends on dedicated pool timeline.
elena (PM): OK — decision tentative: MVP = core inference routes, embeddings, basic telemetry; Pilot = audit-export + banner; v1 = tenant-aware routing + advanced RBAC.
kevin (Design): I'll draft banner + pilot messaging. Will share in #design for review.
maria (Product Ops): I'll sync with sales and draft pilot success criteria: 1) ACME ingest <100k tokens/day, 2) audit export delivered, 3) no routing incidents >1 per week.
sam (Eng): adding a quick cutlist snippet for clarity:
```
MVP (ship): core text gen, embeddings, telemetry
Pilot (ACME): audit-export, pilot UI banner
V1 (next): tenant routing, RBAC, multi-region SLA
```
elena (PM): action items:
- sam: implement fallback routing (this sprint)
- kevin: pilot UX copy (due +3d)
- maria: customer comms & success criteria (due +2d)
- leo: confirm infra ETA for dedicated pool (due EOD)
sam (Eng): noted, will start fallback PR today. @deploy-bot can you add a blocker tag when infra ETA updates?
deploy-bot: noted — will post infra ETA once infra team updates terraform pipeline.
kevin (Design): will post mocks in 24h. :wave:
maria (Product Ops): tagging sales leads for ACME pilot kick: @sarah @josh
elena (PM): thanks all — i'll update roadmap doc and notify execs after infra ETA. If infra ETA stays delayed >2w we revisit rebaseline for v1.
sam (Eng): ack.
leo (SRE): ack.
kevin (Design): ack.

(elena pinned files: /docs/roadmap/q2-release.md)
thread_short: elena (PM): heads-up — Q2 launch slid 2w. propose MVP w/out tenant routing, pilot audit-export for ACME. decisions + action items.
